about: S20 F (#1378) message-formatting vectors. One source of truth: the JS parser (src/components/msg-format.js) and the C# strip (builder S) both read this file. 'strip' = the plain text (reply quote, chat-list preview, search, notification). 'shape' = the render tree: a string is a text run; ["b", ...] bold, ["i", ...] italic, ["s", ...] strike (children are strings / nodes); ["code", "text"] inline code; ["pre", "text"] code block. Adjacent text is merged. 'pending' = vectors the JS passes that the C# strip (S20FormatRules.Strip + csh S20FormatTests' encoded copy) does not carry yet — requests/F-to-S-r1.md; move them into 'vectors' once S mirrors step 0 (S20 S #46 r1: done — the 5 step-0 vectors moved, pending is empty).
grammar: 0. URLs (#46 r1 MINOR-1): when the text is at most 4096 UTF-16 units (LINKIFY_MAX, the #235 cap), every URL the link rule finds (src/components/link-rule.js urlSpans = Spixi/Utils/LinkRule.cs: URL_RE, the glued-token guard, the trailing .,!?;: and unbalanced ')' trims), minus its trailing run of * _ ~ chars, is OPAQUE to step 3: no mark inside it opens or closes. Marks around it still apply. Over the cap nothing is protected (nothing is linked either).

1. Code blocks first. An opening fence is ``` at the start of the text or right after a newline. The block ends at the NEXT ``` anywhere after it; no closing fence = no block (the backticks fall through to step 2 as ordinary text). Content = the text between the fences, with ONE leading newline and ONE trailing newline removed if present (so text right after the opening fence on the same line is content). An EMPTY content is no block: that fence is skipped and the scan moves on by one char. Inside: no other formatting.

2. Inline code in the remaining text: a ` pairs with the next ` on the SAME line; the content must be non-empty. Otherwise the ` is literal and scanning moves on by one char. Inside: no other formatting.

3. Emphasis runs separately in each text run between code spans / blocks (so nothing matches across code). Marks * (b) _ (i) ~ (s). Scan left to right. A mark at i OPENS when (i is the run start OR run[i-1] is not a letter/digit [\p{L}\p{N}]) AND run[i+1] exists and is not whitespace. Its CLOSE is the FIRST j > i+1 with run[j] == the same mark, run[j-1] not whitespace, (j is the run end OR run[j+1] is not a letter/digit), and no newline in run[i+1..j-1]. Found: a node whose children = step 3 applied to run[i+1..j-1] (edges of that inner run count as run edges), continue at j+1. Not found: the mark is literal text, continue at i+1.
4. Strip = the tree's text with marks and fences dropped (code / block content kept as typed). Copy = the text as typed.
